summary: The recorded base reproduces the original post-forward MLA sharded-state KeyError. At the exact candidate commit, an independent loader-level test using an actual safetensors shard loads the runtime alias into the fresh model's canonical parameter and verifies exact tensor values. The mapping is limited to self_attn.attn_mha.kv_b_proj and preserves normal failures for unrelated aliases, oversized tensors, and ambiguous duplicate alias/canonical entries.

tests.what_was_measured: A real safetensors shard containing model.layers.0.self_attn.attn_mha.kv_b_proj.weight raises the original KeyError against a fresh canonical-only state dict. Direct existing aliases still load, while unrelated aliases and invalid cases fail.

The full ShardedStateLoader.load_model safetensors loop resolves the MLA alias and copies exact 2x2 reference values. Direct alias presence succeeds; unrelated q_proj alias, oversized tensor, and duplicate canonical-plus-alias inputs remain rejected.
Candidate regression and boundary tests: 4 passed.

145 passed, 5 skipped, 6 failed. All six failures are pre-existing ModelOpt/ROCm environment incompatibilities or missing ModelOpt behavior and do not exercise the changed ShardedStateLoader alias path.

gpu_execution.evidence: ROCm PyTorch detected one AMD Instinct MI350X (gfx950 capability 9.5). The defect is host-side state-dict naming/loading, so no GPU numerical claim was needed or made.
